leadText: Volume 4 is the fourth volume published by Shogakukan compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and were collected in the regular volumes once the had finished.
plainText:
Volume 4 is the fourth volume published by Shogakukan compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and were collected in the regular volumes once the had finished.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Quilladin Stands
Gyarados Changes
Pyroar Breathes
Flabébé Blooms
Rhyhorn Charges
Pinsir Glares

==Important events==
 

==Party changes==
===Additions===
Y's "Xerxer" in PS581.

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
X's "Salamè" evolves into in PS577.
X's "Marisso" evolves into in PS577.
